description: No surface occupancy in the northernmost portion of the project area (approximately six WTG locations).
geographic_scope: Northernmost portion of the project area
context_quote: Under Alternative C…no surface occupancy would occur in the northernmost portion of the proposed Project area…This alternative would result in the exclusion of approximately six of the northernmost WTG locations.

description: Minimum 1 nautical mile spacing between WTGs.
context_quote: Under Alternative D1, WTGs would have a minimum spacing of 1 nmi between them, and the lanes between turbines would also be a minimum of 1 nmi…

description: East-west orientation with 1 nautical mile minimum spacing.
context_quote: Under Alternative D2, the wind turbine layout would be arranged in an east-west orientation and all WTGs in the east-west direction would have a minimum spacing of 1 nmi between them…

description: No more than 84 WTGs.
context_quote: Under Alternative E…the proposed Project would consist of no more than 84 WTGs…

description: No surface occupancy within vessel transit lane.
geographic_scope: Vessel transit lane through the WDA
context_quote: Under Alternative F, a vessel transit lane through the WDA would be established in which no surface occupancy would occur.

description: Non-HDD cable laying in Nantucket Sound outside April to June.
geographic_scope: Northern part of the offshore export cable area within Nantucket Sound waters
context_quote: The non-HDD cable laying operations in the northern part of the offshore export cable area within Nantucket Sound waters will occur outside of April to June.

description: Cable protection in hard bottom must be natural or engineered stone.
context_quote: Cable protection measures within complex hard-bottom habitat…will consist of natural or engineered stone…

description: Cable protection in Nantucket waters must be natural materials.
context_quote: Additionally, per the Nantucket Order of Conditions…cable protection, where required in Town of Nantucket waters, must consist of natural materials that mimic the surrounding seafloor.

description: Six northeastern turbine placement locations removed.
context_quote: Require Vineyard Wind to not place turbines within the area defined by the six northeastern most turbine locations in the proposed layout…

description: WTGs painted no lighter than RAL 9010 Pure White and no darker than RAL 7035 Light Grey.
context_quote: Require Vineyard Wind to paint the WTGs off-white/light grey (no lighter than RAL 9010 Pure White and no darker than RAL 7035 Light Grey)…

description: WTG rotors must have control mechanisms to shut down within an agreed upon time.
context_quote: Equip all WTG rotors (blade assemblies) with control mechanisms operable from the Vineyard Wind control centers…The control mechanisms shall enable control room operators to shut down the requested WTGs within an agreed upon time of notification between the USCG and Vineyard Wind.

description: Each WTG and ESP must be marked with PATONs, subject to USCG approval.
context_quote: Each WTG and ESP will be marked with PATONs, subject to the approval of the Commander (dpw-1), First Coast Guard District.

description: If ESPs include helicopter landing platforms, they must accommodate USCG HH60 helicopters.
context_quote: If Vineyard Wind's ESPs include helicopter-landing platforms, those platforms will be designed and built to accommodate USCG HH60 rescue helicopters.

description: No pile-driving from December 1 to April 30 (with exceptions).
context_quote: No pile-driving activities may occur from December 1 to April 30 of any year.

description: Export cable conduits installation not initiated between April 1 and August 31.
context_quote: Installation of export cable conduits is not expected to be initiated between April 1 and August 31.

description: Trees greater than 3 inches diameter at breast height not cleared from June 1 to July 31.
context_quote: Require that trees greater than 3 inches (7.6 centimeters) diameter at breast height not be cleared from June 1 to July 31.

description: 500-meter clearance and shutdown zone for pile-driving for North Atlantic right whales.
context_quote: For all pile-driving activities, any large whale that cannot be identified to species by a PSO must be treated as a NARW if it is visually sighted within 1,000 m of the pile for clearance and shutdown purposes any time of the year.

description: Vessel speed 10 knots or less from November 1 through May 14 within the WDA (with exceptions).
geographic_scope: WDA (excluding Nantucket Sound unless an active DMA is in place)
context_quote: From November 1 through May 14, all vessels must travel at 10 knots or less when transiting to, from. or within the WDA, except within Nantucket Sound (unless an active DMA is in place) and except crew transfer vessels as described below.

description: Vessels 65 feet or greater must comply with 10-knot speed restriction in SMAs.
context_quote: All vessels greater than or equal to 65 feet (19.8 meter) in overall length must comply with the 10-knot speed restriction in any SMA…

description: Initial inter-array and export cable inspection within 6 months of commissioning.
context_quote: In federal waters, the initial inter-array and export cable inspection will be carried out within 6 months of commissioning…

description: 1640-foot clearance and shutdown zone for pile-driving for sea turtles.
context_quote: PSOs will establish a 1,640.4-foot (500-meter) clearance and shutdown zone for all pile-driving activities.

description: Vessels must maintain 328-foot separation distance from sea turtles.
context_quote: All vessels must maintain a minimum separation distance of 328 feet (100 meters) from sea turtles whenever possible.

description: Vessels must avoid transiting through jellyfish aggregations or floating vegetation from June 1 to November 30.
context_quote: Between June 1 and November 30, vessels must avoid transiting through areas of visible jellyfish aggregations or floating vegetation lines or mats.
